item.subject: science
item.chapter_label: Earth, Sun and the apparent motion of the sky
item.stem: Meena watches the full Moon slowly darken during a lunar eclipse from her terrace in Jaipur. Her friends give different explanations. Which explanation of a lunar eclipse is correct?

options.A: Ravi: The Moon comes between the Sun and Earth, so the Moon's shadow falls on Earth.
options.B: Sunita: Earth comes between the Sun and the Moon, so Earth's shadow falls on the Moon.
options.C: Arjun: The Moon stops giving out its own light for some time.
options.D: Farah: Clouds in the sky cover the Moon and make it look dark.
